Event group (spindle): Spindle event name (specific to the detection algorithm)
Channel label(s) where the spindle was detected
Sleep stage during which the spindle occurred (1=N1, 2=N2, 3=N3, 5=REM)
Sleep cycle number (1-based) during which the spindle occurred
Spindle dominant frequency (Hz), where spectral energy is maximum
Duration (s) from spindle onset to the maximum peak-to-peak amplitude
RMS Spindle Activity Index component: RMS amplitude x spindle duration (uV sec)
